pages.text: Hands can hold the right two things and still do nothing useful. The missing piece is an $(thing)idea$().$(br2)Hold the things you are wondering about, and hold $(k:hominin_evolution.think). Do it with a full stomach and an unhurt body. A brain is hungry, and ideas are expensive.

Try to make something before you have thought of it, and your hands will fumble. Sometimes they will break what they are holding.$(br2)This is not punishment. It is how every idea anyone ever had was paid for.
Not every thought needs something to hold.$(br2)Empty your hands, fill your stomach, and let the mind wander to yesterday. It is a strange place to go. Go there anyway.
